npc32.item:
The Cherry Blossom Tree is a tree with unusual powers. Unfortunately, Kundun's army found the tree and stole all its flowers. While running away, they lost many flowers from their bags. Bring back Cherry Blossom branches and receive a reward.

You'll have to collect 5 White, or 5 Red, or 5 Golden Cherry Blossom branches for a reward. Price: 1,000 Zen.
